name: coffee-drinker
description: Coffee Drinker — full-stack demo (Express API + Next.js client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:server: echo '(server is run from source — nothing to build)'
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
